problem_en: Project A requires an initial investment of 5,00,000 and yields 3,00,000 at the end of year 1 and 4,00,000 at the end of year 2. Project B requires 6,00,000 and yields 8,00,000 at the end of year 2. If the discount rate is 10% per annum, calculate the absolute difference between the Net Present Values (NPV) of the two projects.
problem_hi: परियोजना A के लिए 5,00,000 के शुरुआती निवेश की आवश्यकता है और यह वर्ष 1 के अंत में 3,00,000 और वर्ष 2 के अंत में 4,00,000 का लाभ देती है। परियोजना B के लिए 6,00,000 की आवश्यकता है और यह वर्ष 2 के अंत में 8,00,000 का लाभ देती है। यदि छूट की दर 10% प्रति वर्ष है, तो दोनों परियोजनाओं के शुद्ध वर्तमान मूल्य (NPV) के बीच पूर्ण अंतर की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Project A requires initial investment of 5,00,000 and yields 3,00,000 year 1 end mein aur 4,00,000 year 2 end mein. Project B requires 6,00,000 and yields 8,00,000 at year 2 end. Discount rate 10% p.a. hai, toh dono projects ke NPV ka absolute difference find karo.
problem_hg_065: Project A mein 5 lakh lagaye, return mila 3 lakh 75 hazaar saal ke end mein par actual calculation 3 lakh first year and 4 lakh second year ke liye karo. Project B takes 6 lakh and returns 8 lakh after 2 years. Discount rate 10% hai. Dono NPVs ka difference nikalo.
solution_steps_en: Step 3: Difference = |103305.78 - 61157.02| = 42148.76. Wait, re-calculating with exact fractions.
Step 5: Absolute Difference = 103305.7851 - 61157.0248 = 42148.7603. Let's re-verify the prompt numbers for a unique deterministic answer.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: The trap provides a distractor '3 lakh 75 hazaar' which the LLM might use as the Year 1 cash flow instead of the corrected '3 lakh' specified immediately after.
why_hard: Requires simultaneous calculation of multiple discounted cash flow streams and precise decimal handling for an absolute difference.

problem_en: An investor is choosing between two bonds. Bond X pays 1,20,000 annually for 3 years, starting one year from now. Bond Y pays 4,00,000 at the end of year 3. If the market interest rate is 8%, which bond has a higher present value and by how much? Provide the numerical difference.
problem_hi: एक निवेशक दो बॉन्ड के बीच चयन कर रहा है। बॉन्ड X अब से एक साल बाद शुरू होकर 3 साल के लिए सालाना 1,20,000 का भुगतान करता है। बॉन्ड Y वर्ष 3 के अंत में 4,00,000 का भुगतान करता है। यदि बाजार ब्याज दर 8% है, तो किस बॉन्ड का वर्तमान मूल्य अधिक है और कितना? संख्यात्मक अंतर प्रदान करें।
problem_hg_030: Investor 2 bonds choose kar raha hai. Bond X pays 1,20,000 annually for 3 years. Bond Y pays 4,00,000 year 3 end mein. Market interest rate 8% hai. Kiska PV zyada hai and numerical difference calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: Bond X har saal 1,20,000 deta hai 3 years tak. Bond Y seedha 4,00,000 deta hai 3 years baad. Interest 8% hai. Pehle karo calculation X ka phir Y ka subtraction karke difference batao. Dono ko compare karke value nikalo.
solution_steps_en: Step 3: Difference = 317532.65 - 309251.52 = 8281.13. Let's re-calculate with higher precision.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir: The trap suggests a specific sequence 'Pehle karo calculation X ka phir Y ka subtraction' which might lead the LLM to follow a rigid path that ignores the sign of the difference or incorrectly pairs the subtraction.
why_hard: Requires contrasting an ordinary annuity formula with a single-sum present value formula over a multi-year horizon.

problem_en: You invest 2,00,000 today in a fund that grows at 12% compounded semi-annually. Another fund offers 2,00,000 today at 12.2% compounded annually. Calculate the difference in the accumulated amounts after 2 years.
problem_hi: आप आज एक फंड में 2,00,000 निवेश करते हैं जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित 12% की दर से बढ़ता है। एक अन्य फंड 12.2% वार्षिक संयोजित दर पर आज 2,00,000 का निवेश प्रदान करता है। 2 वर्ष बाद संचित राशियों में अंतर की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Aap 2,00,000 invest karte ho growing at 12% semi-annually compounded. Another fund 12.2% annually compound hota hai. 2 years baad accumulated amounts ka difference kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: Aaj 2 lakh invest kiye 12% rate par. Par 6 mahine baad interest compound hota hai first option mein. Second option 12.2% annual compounding hai. 2 saal ka total difference calculate karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad: In an annual rate problem, '6 mahine baad' usually triggers semi-annual compounding logic, but an LLM might misinterpret it as a delay in investment or only apply interest after the first 6 months.
why_hard: Tests the ability to distinguish between nominal rates with different compounding frequencies (Effective Annual Rate logic).

problem_en: Option 1: Receive 5,00,000 now. Option 2: Receive 1,50,000 at the end of each year for 4 years. If the interest rate is 6% per annum, find the difference between the present value of Option 2 and Option 1.
problem_hi: विकल्प 1: अभी 5,00,000 प्राप्त करें। विकल्प 2: 4 वर्षों के लिए प्रत्येक वर्ष के अंत में 1,50,000 प्राप्त करें। यदि ब्याज दर 6% प्रति वर्ष है, तो विकल्प 2 और विकल्प 1 के वर्तमान मूल्य के बीच का अंतर ज्ञात करें।
problem_hg_030: Option 1: 5,00,000 abhi milenge. Option 2: 1,50,000 har saal end mein for 4 years. Rate 6% p.a. hai. Option 2 aur Option 1 ke present value ka difference find karo.
problem_hg_065: Option 1 mein abhi 5 lakh le lo. Option 2 mein 1,50,000 har saal milenge total 4 times. Rate 6% hai. Baaki calculation karke batao ki Option 2 ka PV Option 1 se kitna kam ya zyada hai.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki: The 'baaki' trap implies a remainder calculation. An LLM might try to subtract the total nominal amount (6,00,000) from the 5,00,000 instead of comparing present values.
why_hard: Requires comparing an immediate lump sum with a multi-period annuity discounted to the present.

problem_en: A machine costs 10,00,000 and has a useful life of 2 years. It generates cash flows of 6,00,000 in year 1 and 6,00,000 in year 2. A second machine costs 9,00,000 and generates 5,00,000 in year 1 and 7,00,000 in year 2. With a discount rate of 15%, find the difference in NPV between the two machines.
problem_hi: एक मशीन की लागत 10,00,000 है और इसका उपयोगी जीवन 2 वर्ष है। यह वर्ष 1 में 6,00,000 और वर्ष 2 में 6,00,000 का नकद प्रवाह उत्पन्न करती है। दूसरी मशीन की लागत 9,00,000 है और यह वर्ष 1 में 5,00,000 और वर्ष 2 में 7,00,000 उत्पन्न करती है। 15% की छूट दर के साथ, दोनों मशीनों के बीच NPV का अंतर ज्ञात करें।
problem_hg_030: Machine 1 cost 10,00,000, yields 6,00,000 in yr 1 and yr 2. Machine 2 cost 9,00,000, yields 5,00,000 in yr 1 and 7,00,000 in yr 2. 15% discount rate par dono ka NPV difference nikalo.
problem_hg_065: Pehli machine 10 lakh ki hai, har saal 6 lakh degi 2 saal tak. Dusri machine 9 lakh ki hai, pehle 5 lakh phir 7 lakh degi. 15% rate hai. Dono ko calculate karke NPV ka difference batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko: 'Dono ko' implies a summation or a joint action. An LLM might attempt to add the NPVs of both machines instead of finding the difference as requested.
why_hard: Involves negative NPV results and requires accurate handling of signed numbers during the comparison.

problem_en: Investment P offers 10,00,000 after 5 years at a discount rate of 10%. Investment Q offers 10,00,000 after 4 years at a discount rate of 12%. Find the absolute difference in their present values.
problem_hi: निवेश P 10% की छूट दर पर 5 वर्ष बाद 10,00,000 प्रदान करता है। निवेश Q 12% की छूट दर पर 4 वर्ष बाद 10,00,000 प्रदान करता है। उनके वर्तमान मूल्यों में पूर्ण अंतर ज्ञात करें।
problem_hg_030: Investment P offers 10,00,000 after 5 years (rate 10%). Investment Q offers 10,00,000 after 4 years (rate 12%). Dono ke present values ka absolute difference find karein.
problem_hg_065: Investment P mein 10 lakh milenge 5 saal baad (10% rate). Q mein 10 lakh milenge 4 saal baad (12% rate). Withdraw kar liya 10 lakh ki term ko as final value, ab PV ka difference nikalo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad: The trap uses 'Withdraw kar liya' metaphorically for the term '10 lakh', but the LLM might interpret this as a premature withdrawal from a compound interest account, affecting the time 'n'.
why_hard: Requires calculations with different discount rates and different time horizons simultaneously.

problem_en: A company plans to buy a vehicle for 15,00,000. It will save 4,00,000 at the end of every year for 5 years in maintenance costs. If the discount rate is 9%, calculate the NPV of this purchase.
problem_hi: एक कंपनी 15,00,000 में एक वाहन खरीदने की योजना बना रही है। यह 5 वर्षों के लिए प्रत्येक वर्ष के अंत में रखरखाव लागत में 4,00,000 की बचत करेगा। यदि छूट की दर 9% है, तो इस खरीद के NPV की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Company 15,00,000 ka vehicle kharid rahi hai. 5 years tak har saal end mein 4,00,000 maintenance bachega. Discount rate 9% hai, NPV calculate karo.
problem_hg_065: Vehicle 15 lakh ka hai. Har saal 4 lakh bachega maintenance mein. 10 aur log aaye maintenance check karne par tum 5 years ka period lo at 9% rate. NPV kya hoga?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye: The trap '10 aur log aaye' (10 more people came) is an additive distractor. The LLM might add 10 to the interest rate (making it 19%) or to the years (making it 15).
why_hard: Tests the translation of 'cost savings' into positive cash flows for NPV calculation.

problem_en: You have 8,00,000 to invest. Scheme A offers 12% simple interest for 4 years. Scheme B offers 10% compound interest per annum for 4 years. Find the difference in the interest earned between the two schemes.
problem_hi: आपके पास निवेश करने के लिए 8,00,000 हैं। योजना A 4 वर्षों के लिए 12% साधारण ब्याज प्रदान करती है। योजना B 4 वर्षों के लिए 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज प्रदान करती है। दोनों योजनाओं के बीच अर्जित ब्याज में अंतर ज्ञात करें।
problem_hg_030: Aapke paas 8,00,000 invest karne ke liye hain. Scheme A 12% simple interest deti hai 4 years ke liye. Scheme B 10% compound interest p.a. deti hai for 4 years. Interest earned ka difference find karein.
problem_hg_065: 8 lakh invest karo. Scheme A mein 12% simple interest hai. Scheme B mein 10% compound interest hai. A se 20% zyada base mat lena calculation mein, bas 4 saal ka interest difference nikalna.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada: This trap leads the LLM to think that Scheme B's interest or principal is 20% more than A's, rather than calculating the values as stated.
why_hard: Requires switching between simple and compound interest logic and calculating interest-only components rather than total amounts.

problem_en: Calculate the Present Value of a growing perpetuity that pays 50,000 next year, with payments growing at 4% per year, and a discount rate of 10%. Also calculate a 20-year annuity with the same initial payment and growth. Find the difference.
problem_hi: एक बढ़ती हुई निरंतरता (growing perpetuity) के वर्तमान मूल्य की गणना करें जो अगले वर्ष 50,000 का भुगतान करती है, जिसमें भुगतान 4% प्रति वर्ष की दर से बढ़ रहे हैं, और छूट की दर 10% है। उसी प्रारंभिक भुगतान और वृद्धि के साथ 20-वर्षीय वार्षिकवृत्ति (annuity) की गणना भी करें। दोनों के बीच अंतर ज्ञात करें।
problem_hg_030: Growing perpetuity ka PV nikalo (first payment 50,000, growth 4%, rate 10%). Phir 20-year growing annuity ka PV nikalo with same parameters. Dono ka difference find karein.
problem_hg_065: Pehle growing perpetuity calculate karo (50k next year, 4% growth, 10% rate). Phir 20 saal ki growing annuity dekho. Pehle karo perpetuity phir annuity aur subtraction se difference nikalo.
solution_steps_en: Step 2: PV Growing Annuity = [C / (r - g)] * [1 - ((1 + g) / (1 + r))^n]
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir: Commands a sequence that might distract the LLM from the complex 'growth' part of the annuity formula, leading to the use of a standard annuity formula instead.
why_hard: Involves the most complex TVM formulas (growing perpetuity and growing annuity) and requires precise power calculations.

problem_en: Two investment projects are being compared. Project 1 costs 2,50,000 and pays 3,50,000 in 3 years. Project 2 costs 2,50,000 and pays 1,00,000 each year for 3 years. If the cost of capital is 7%, calculate the NPV difference.
problem_hi: दो निवेश परियोजनाओं की तुलना की जा रही है। परियोजना 1 की लागत 2,50,000 है और 3 वर्षों में 3,50,000 का भुगतान करती है। परियोजना 2 की लागत 2,50,000 है और 3 वर्षों के लिए प्रत्येक वर्ष 1,00,000 का भुगतान करती है। यदि पूंजी की लागत 7% है, तो NPV अंतर की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: Two projects comparison: Project 1 cost 2,50,000 and pays 3,50,000 in 3 yrs. Project 2 cost 2,50,000 and pays 1,00,000 for 3 yrs. Cost of capital 7% hai. NPV difference nikalo.
problem_hg_065: Project 1 mein 2,50,000 lagao aur 3 saal baad 3,50,000 pao. Project 2 mein 1 lakh har saal milega 3 saal tak. Rate 7% hai. Na Project 1 se na Project 2 se calculation skip karna, difference batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible: The trap 'na X se na Y se' (neither X nor Y) here used to say 'don't skip either', but phrased to mimic a logical 'neither/nor' condition which might make the LLM exclude certain years or values.
why_hard: Requires calculating a future lump sum PV vs an annuity PV and finding the delta.

problem_en: A debt of 10,00,000 is to be amortized in 4 equal annual installments at 10% interest. Another debt of 10,00,000 is to be paid back as a single lump sum of 14,50,000 after 4 years. Compare the present values of the two payment plans at a discount rate of 10%.
problem_hi: 10,00,000 के ऋण को 10% ब्याज पर 4 समान वार्षिक किस्तों में चुकाया जाना है। 10,00,000 के एक अन्य ऋण को 4 वर्ष बाद 14,50,000 की एकल एकमुश्त राशि के रूप में वापस किया जाना है। 10% की छूट दर पर दोनों भुगतान योजनाओं के वर्तमान मूल्यों की तुलना करें।
problem_hg_030: 10,00,000 ka loan 4 equal installments mein amortize karna hai (10% rate). Second plan: 10,00,000 loan, 14,50,000 lump sum after 4 yrs. 10% discount rate par PVs compare karo.
problem_hg_065: 10 lakh ka loan 4 installments mein bharna hai (10% rate). Second plan mein seedha 14,50,000 dena hai 4 years baad. 6 mahine baad installments wala calculation mat badalna. PV difference nikalo.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Plan 1 is an amortization at 10% discounted at 10%, so PV = 1000000.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad: The trap '6 mahine baad' might mislead the LLM into thinking installments are semi-annual, even though 'annual installments' was specified in the primary description.
why_hard: The first plan is a conceptual trap (PV of market-rate amortized loan is the principal) while the second is a straight calculation.

problem_en: Calculate the difference between the Future Value of an annuity due and an ordinary annuity. Both have annual payments of 1,00,000 for 5 years at an interest rate of 8%.
problem_hi: एक देय वार्षिकवृत्ति (annuity due) और एक साधारण वार्षिकवृत्ति (ordinary annuity) के भविष्य के मूल्य के बीच अंतर की गणना करें। दोनों में 8% की ब्याज दर पर 5 वर्षों के लिए 1,00,000 का वार्षिक भुगतान है।
problem_hg_030: Annuity due aur ordinary annuity ke Future Value mein difference nikalo. Har payment 1,00,00, period 5 yrs, rate 8%.
problem_hg_065: Annuity due vs ordinary annuity ka FV difference nikalo. Har saal 1,00,000 pay karne hain 5 years tak. Rate 8% hai. Pehle karo ordinary phir annuity due. Difference batao.
solution_steps_en: Step 2: FV Annuity Due = FV Ordinary * (1 + r) = 586660 * 1.08 = 633592.80
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir: A sequential trap that might lead the LLM to skip the multiplicative factor (1+r) needed for the annuity due if it gets confused by the order.
why_hard: Requires precise knowledge of the timing difference between ordinary annuities and annuities due.

problem_en: Bond A pays 5,00,000 in 10 years. Bond B pays 2,50,000 in 5 years. If the market rate is 5% compounded annually, find the difference in their present values.
problem_hi: बॉन्ड A 10 वर्षों में 5,00,000 का भुगतान करता है। बॉन्ड B 5 वर्षों में 2,50,000 का भुगतान करता है। यदि बाजार दर 5% वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित है, तो उनके वर्तमान मूल्यों में अंतर ज्ञात करें।
problem_hg_030: Bond A pays 5,00,000 in 10 yrs. Bond B pays 2,50,000 in 5 yrs. Market rate 5% p.a. PV ka difference nikalo.
problem_hg_065: Bond A 10 saal baad 5 lakh dega. Bond B 5 saal baad 2,50,000 dega. Interest rate 5% hai. Dono ko discount karo aur difference find karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko: 'Dono ko discount karo' is straightforward, but the juxtaposition of two bonds with same-ratio payment/time (500k/10y vs 250k/5y) might trick the LLM into thinking the PVs are equal due to a linear time-value error.
why_hard: Exposes the non-linear nature of time value of money discounting across different periods.

problem_en: An investment of 1,00,000 grows for 10 years. For the first 5 years, the rate is 8% compounded annually. For the next 5 years, the rate is 10% compounded annually. Calculate the final future value.
problem_hi: 1,00,000 का निवेश 10 वर्षों के लिए बढ़ता है। पहले 5 वर्षों के लिए, दर 8% वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित है। अगले 5 वर्षों के लिए, दर 10% वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित है। अंतिम भविष्य के मूल्य की गणना करें।
problem_hg_030: 1,00,000 ka investment 10 years ke liye hai. First 5 yrs rate is 8% p.a. Next 5 yrs rate is 10% p.a. Final Future Value nikalo.
problem_hg_065: 1 lakh invest kiya 10 years ke liye. Pehle 5 saal 8% rate mila, baaki period mein 10% mila. Withdraw kar liya interest har saal mat sochna, final value nikalo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki: The 'baaki' (remaining) trap is used to define the second time period. The LLM might miscalculate the remaining years if it interprets 'baaki' as a subtraction of something other than time.
why_hard: Requires multi-stage compounding where the output of the first stage becomes the input for the second.

problem_en: You deposit 2,00,000 in an account paying 6% compounded monthly. Calculate the amount in the account after 1 year. Compare this to a deposit of 2,00,000 in an account paying 6.1% compounded annually for 1 year. Find the difference.
problem_hi: आप मासिक रूप से संयोजित 6% के खाते में 2,00,000 जमा करते हैं। 1 वर्ष बाद खाते में राशि की गणना करें। इसकी तुलना 1 वर्ष के लिए वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित 6.1% के खाते में 2,00,000 के जमा से करें। अंतर ज्ञात करें।
problem_hg_030: 2,00,000 deposit kiya at 6% compounded monthly. 1 year baad amount nikalo. Compare it to 2,00,000 at 6.1% annually for 1 year. Difference find karein.
problem_hg_065: 2 lakh deposit kiye 6% rate par. Monthly compounding hai. Second scheme 6.1% annual hai. Dono ko 1 saal baad check karo aur difference nikalo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko: 'Dono ko 1 saal baad check karo' - The simple phrasing might hide the complexity of monthly compounding (requiring 1.005 to the 12th power).
why_hard: Requires high-precision exponentiation for monthly compounding compared against a higher nominal annual rate.
